content.short: De.Fi is a Web3 security and portfolio super app with antivirus tools, dashboards, and DeFi analytics.
content.description: De.Fi is a Web3 security and portfolio platform that combines wallet tracking, DeFi analytics, risk tooling, and antivirus-style protection. The product supports many blockchains, including Cardano-related coverage, and helps users monitor positions, find yields, inspect protocols, and protect themselves from risky contracts or suspicious activity. Its value is consolidation: users can review assets, protocol exposure, and security signals from one dashboard. De.Fi fits Cardano as part of the broader multichain DeFi safety layer.
content.meta: De.Fi offers Web3 security, portfolio tracking, DeFi analytics, and antivirus tools for users. Explore De.Fi on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
